canonical.title: Weekend at Nuance: a 2-Michelin dinner with no hotel next door

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Nuance
siblings.summary: Mechelen 5 min by train, Antwerp 15 min, Lier 9 min by bus — plus the Sunday-museum / Monday-shop rhythm.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Nuance
siblings.summary: There is no true walking-distance hotel near Nuance; the restaurant's picks are Mechelen hotels via Taxi Symforosa.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Nuance
siblings.summary: Heritage and design hotels — convents, orphanages, city palaces — within 10-25 min taxi of Nuance.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Nuance
siblings.summary: 2026 calendar of IT conferences inside a 30 km radius of Nuance — bundling options for the Saturday-dinner trip.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Nuance, Duffel
sources.claim: Nuance is a two-star Michelin restaurant in Duffel led by chef Thierry Theys; address Kiliaanstraat 8, 2570 Duffel.

sources.title: a-hotel.com — Duffel directory
sources.claim: Duffel has 0 hotels and 0 apartments in the entire municipality; only 3 small pensions exist.

sources.title: Nuance — Recommended hotels & transport
sources.claim: Nuance's own 4 partner hotels (Mechelen + Antwerp) reached by Taxi Symforosa.

sources.title: Nuance — Official site
sources.claim: Nuance restaurant at Kiliaanstraat 6-8, 2570 Duffel.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Duffel to Mechelen
sources.claim: Duffel-to-Mechelen by train is 7-12 min direct.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Duffel to Antwerp Central
sources.claim: Trains from Duffel to Antwerpen-Centraal run hourly, ~24 min for €3-7.

sources.title: De Lijn — Line 30 Mechelen-Duffel-Lier
sources.claim: De Lijn line 30 connects Mechelen-Duffel-Lier; bus to Lier ~9 min.

sources.title: Martin's Patershof Mechelen
sources.claim: Martin's Patershof — restored neo-Gothic convent (1863), 79 rooms, breakfast in the church choir.

sources.title: Visit Mechelen — St. Rumbold's Tower Skywalk
sources.claim: St. Rumbold's Tower — 97m, Skywalk 538 steps, daily 1-6pm and Sat 10-6pm, adults €8.

sources.title: KMSKA — Hours and tickets
sources.claim: KMSKA opens 10:00-18:00 Sat/Sun, closed Mondays.

sources.title: Tripbytrip — Rubens House reopening 2030
sources.claim: Rubens House main building closed for restoration through ~2030.

sources.title: MoMu — Visitor information
sources.claim: MoMu Fashion Museum shut from May 2026 through March 2027.

sources.title: DIVA — Opening hours
sources.claim: DIVA opens daily 10-18 except Wednesdays — the one major Antwerp museum reliably open on Mondays.

sources.title: Hof van Aragon — Lier
sources.claim: Hof van Aragon — 16th-c former girls' orphanage 'Maegdenhuys', oldest hotel in Lier.

sources.title: Montransport — Taxi in Lier
sources.claim: Lier has no taxi ranks — pre-book the return leg before dinner.

sources.title: Fedasil — Belgian shop hours
sources.claim: Belgian shops open Mon-Sat 10-18, closed Sundays.

sources.title: Introducing Brussels — Opening times
sources.claim: Most Belgian museums closed on Mondays, open on Sundays.

sources.title: DDD Europe 2026
sources.claim: DDD Europe — Workshops 8-10 June, Conference 10-12 June 2026 at Queen Elisabeth Hall, Antwerp.

sources.title: BC TechDays 2026
sources.claim: BC TechDays — 11-12 June 2026, Kinepolis Event Center, Antwerp.

sources.title: Devoxx Belgium 2026
sources.claim: Devoxx Belgium — 5-9 October 2026, Kinepolis Antwerp, theme 'From Developer to Builder'.

sources.title: SmashingConf Antwerp 2026
sources.claim: SmashingConf — 12-15 October 2026, The Bourla theatre, Antwerp.

sources.title: dataMinds Connect 2026
sources.claim: dataMinds Connect — 12-14 October 2026, Lamot Mechelen.

sources.title: dataMinds Saturday 2026
sources.claim: dataMinds Saturday — free, Sat 21 Feb 2026 at Thomas More College, Mechelen.

sources.title: Het Anker — Geniettour
sources.claim: Het Anker brewery 'Enjoy Tour' — Gouden Carolus tasting + rooftop, 1h45.

sources.title: Taxi Symforosa
sources.claim: Taxi Symforosa — Nuance's transport partner; €3.50 dispatch + per-km + €3 night surcharge 22:00-06:00.

sources.title: Hotel Julien Antwerp
sources.claim: Hotel Julien — two restored 16th-c townhouses in central Antwerp, 20 rooms + 1 suite, Peter Ivens design.

sources.title: Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp
sources.claim: Botanic Sanctuary — 5-star superior in restored 15th-c monastery complex, 108 rooms, ~$460+/night.

sources.title: August Antwerp
sources.claim: August — former Augustinian convent in Het Groen Kwartier, 44 rooms, Vincent Van Duysen.

sources.title: Sapphire House Antwerp
sources.claim: Sapphire House — Autograph Collection 5-star in 16th-c city palace 'Den Grooten Robijn', 139 rooms.

sources.title: Hotel Elisabeth Mechelen
sources.claim: Hotel Elisabeth — 66 rooms in interwar former hospital, 5 min walk from St. Rumbold's.

sources.title: MAS Antwerp
sources.claim: MAS — Tue-Sun 10-17, rooftop boulevard open until 22:00, free view.

sources.title: UNESCO — Plantin-Moretus
sources.claim: Plantin-Moretus printing complex — only surviving Renaissance/Baroque printing workshop in the world.

sources.title: Visit Mechelen — Vismarkt
sources.claim: Vismarkt — 16th-c former fish market, now Mechelen's drinking and dining heart.

sources.title: Visit Lier — Beguinage
sources.claim: Lier Beguinage — UNESCO 1998, 13th-c, 11 streets and 95 small houses.

sources.title: Techorama 2026
sources.claim: Techorama — 11-13 May 2026 at Kinepolis Antwerp, .NET/Azure/AI/DevOps focus.
